files.purpose: Defines the chat chrome row's Hydra mark button (HydraButton): a dragon-head mark that, when Hydra is on for the thread, is surrounded by a charge ring of the first six roster persona colours and a radial accent glow, and carries a top-trailing badge counting running heads (or a MiniSpinner pulse while isSending, a 0.9 s flag set whenever `running` grows, including from an already non-zero count, or while the lead is delegating before any head runs). A left tap (on the mark or on the badge, which sits inside the button label) never checks isOn: it shows the first-run intro popover until hasSeenHydraIntro is set, otherwise an idle explanation popover when no heads exist, otherwise toggles the floating Hydra panel via runtime.isHydraPanelHidden; a right-click or control-click (caught by an AppKit local event monitor in HydraRightTapHost) opens a per-chat on/off switch popover. The file also contains the Core Animation implementation of the moving charge (HydraChargeLayerView, a 4 s linear conic-gradient turn plus 1.4 s autoreversing opacity breaths anchored to the shared media clock) and the HydraPairSummary enum that renders Hydra pairs as one-line strings used by tooltips, rows and popovers elsewhere.

feature_notes: Tap order (line 37): `if !model.settings.hasSeenHydraIntro { isIntroShown = true } else if heads.isEmpty { isExplaining = true } else { togglePanel() }`. No branch checks isOn: with Hydra off for the chat and no heads a left tap still opens HydraIdlePopover, whose first line is always PopoverSectionHeader("Hydra is on") (line 305); with heads present it toggles the panel. Only onAppear checks isOn (line 93: opens the intro when !hasSeenHydraIntro && isOn).
Intro dismiss closure: model.settings.hasSeenHydraIntro = true; isIntroShown = false.
isSending: .onChange(of: running) sets isSending = true only when new > old; .task(id: isSending) sleeps 0.9 s then sets false unless cancelled.

isLeadDelegating walks entries from last backwards while entry.turnID equals the last entry's turnID; returns true on a .tool call with kind .agent and status .running, or an .assistant message holding a delegation block (streaming: incremental opener scan; finished: cached full check).

hasDelegationBlockWhileStreaming: returns true if row already found; if utf8 count equals scanned returns false; rescans from 0 if text shrank, else from max(0, scanned - 32) bytes (32-byte overlap for a split fence); clears the whole map when count > 64 before storing (count, found).
hasDelegationBlock caches HydraPrompts.hasDelegationBlock(in:) per row id in RecentCache limit 32.

Right-tap capture: event must be in the host's window, host not hidden, bounds non-empty, and event.type == .rightMouseDown or modifierFlags contain .control; point converted from window coordinates must be inside bounds. Caught events run action (toggle isHydraSwitchShown) and are swallowed; others pass through.
Charge motion selection: HydraChargeMotion only when isWorking (running > 0) and reduce motion is off; otherwise still glow(breathing:false) + ring(turned:false).

HydraChargeLayerView.configure recolours only when colors or accent differ; installs animations only if ring has no animation under key "turn". Animations are reinstalled on viewDidMoveToWindow (with colours), app becoming active (if in a window), and the view's own window's occlusion change to visible. installAnimations removes all animations on ring and glow, then adds them with beginTime = ring.convertTime(1, from: nil) so phase follows the shared clock. Ring turn fromValue 0 toValue -2*pi (clockwise on y-up layer).

applyColors: resolves accent within effectiveAppearance.performAsCurrentDrawingAppearance; glow colours [accent alpha 0.46, accent alpha 0]; ring colours (colors + [first]).reversed(); glow locations [2/15, 1]; glow endPoint (0.5 + 15/width, 0.5 + 15/height).
Implicit actions disabled on glow, ring and ringMask for keys opacity, bounds, position, colors, endPoint, cornerRadius, path, transform.
themeDidChange sets accent = Chrome.accentNSColor then applyColors.

HydraPairSummary.workerModel: pair.workerModel resolved against the HEADS provider, `registry.model(model, for: pair.headsProvider)?.shortName ?? model` (line 654); else if sendsHeadsElsewhere `registry.defaultModel(for: pair.headsProvider)?.shortName`; else nil.

HydraPairSummary.workers: "Heads on <model>" plus " (<headsProvider.displayName>)" when sendsHeadsElsewhere; else "Heads on <headsProvider.displayName>" when elsewhere; else "Heads on the chat's model"; then "<effortTitle> effort" when workerEffort set; joined " · ".
HydraPairSummary.providers: "<provider> lead, <headsProvider> heads" when elsewhere, else provider.displayName.

HydraPairSummary.efforts: both set and equal -> "<lead.capitalized> effort"; both differ -> "Lead <lead>, heads <heads> effort"; lead only -> "Lead <lead> effort"; heads only -> "Heads <heads> effort"; none -> nil (titles lowercased first).

HydraPairSummary.modelsTitle: lead resolved against the LEAD provider, `pair.orchestratorModel.map { registry.model($0, for: pair.provider)?.shortName ?? $0 } ?? "Any \(pair.provider.displayName) model"` (line 699), a different provider from workerModel's lookup; worker = workerModel or headsProvider.displayName when elsewhere; no worker -> "<lead> + itself"; else "<lead> + <worker>". title returns customName ?? modelsTitle. The doc comment example "Any model + Sonnet" (line 695) is stale: the code prints "Any <provider displayName> model".

B1->B2: two changes only. (1) HydraRightTapHost.deinit changed from `deinit { removeMonitor() }` to `deinit { MainActor.assumeIsolated { removeMonitor() } }` (line 264). (2) HydraSendWorkingBadge's count text font changed from `.system(size: 9, weight: .bold).monospacedDigit()` to `.system(.caption2, weight: .bold).monospacedDigit()` (line 630). Line count unchanged at 711.

isSending is not a lead-sending state: `.onChange(of: running) { old, new in guard new > old else { return }; isSending = true }` (lines 64-67), so whenever another head starts (e.g. 1 -> 2) the badge shows the MiniSpinner instead of the count for 0.9 s; the badge receives `isSending: isSending || isDelegating` (line 54).
unresolved_questions: When isOn is false the tooltip reads "Hydra is on in Settings" and panelHelp always begins "Hydra is on"; whether the mark is ever rendered with isOn false depends on the caller (not in this file) and on model.hydraIsOn semantics.

Resolved: every other B2 font change in this bundle keeps the macOS default size of its new style (17->.title2, 15->.title3, 13->.body, 12->.callout, 11->.subheadline, 10->.footnote); the two exceptions are 9 pt -> .caption2 (this badge count, line 630, and the HydraMergePopover arrow.right, line 166), which at the macOS default caption2 of 10 pt are +1 pt. A grep of B2 DroppyCode for dynamicTypeSize, textScale and chatZoom finds nothing, so no app-wide scaling applies; the Windows port should use 10 pt.
Definitions of HydraPrompts.hasDelegationBlock / hasDelegationOpener, RecentCache, Chrome.panelSlide / Chrome.hover curves, MiniSpinner and HydraMarkImage live in other files.

files.purpose: Provides the popovers opened from a Hydra head's pill: HydraHeadReportPopover shows a finished (or running) head's report as rendered markdown under a fixed header, and HydraBriefPopover shows the lead's brief to a head the same way. Both share HydraPopoverHeader, which lays out the head's persona glyph, name, a status caption and its task title with an optional trailing accessory such as a CopyButton, and both scroll their body inside PopoverScroll capped at 460 pt tall.

feature_notes: parse algorithm: split body on "\n"; trim each line; an empty line ends the Heads section and is skipped; the exact line "Heads" starts the Heads section; inside it, lines starting "- " are matched whole against the head regex (non-matching '- ' lines are silently dropped) and always skipped as notes; a non-'- ' line ends the section and falls through to normal handling.
Head parse: name = group 1, index = Int(group 2) ?? 0, task = group 3; files = group 5 split on ", " only when group 4 is non-nil and group 5 non-empty, else [] (the 'no files' alternative).

Files line (line 60): `if let found = line.wholeMatch(of: #/(\d+) files? \(\+(\d+) −(\d+)\) landed on `([^`]+)` from `([^`]+)`\./#), match == nil {`. The `match == nil` test is part of the if condition, so only the first matching files line sets files, additions, deletions, target (group 4), branch (group 5); a second matching files line fails the if, falls through to the "is up to date." check and then `notes.append(line.replacingOccurrences(of: "`", with: ""))`, becoming an info note with its backticks removed. For the first match, if any of the three numbers fails Int() the line is skipped with `else { continue }` (not treated as a note). Format: "<n> file(s) (+<a> −<d>) landed on `<target>` from `<branch>`."
Lines ending "is up to date." are dropped; every other line (including a second files line) becomes a note with all backticks removed.
No files line -> parse returns nil.
Copy link: ignored while didCopyLink is true; sets didCopyLink true with .snappy(duration: 0.22), then after Task.sleep 1.4 s sets it false with the same animation.
Favicon: FaviconCache.cached(host:) first; otherwise awaits FaviconCache.image(for: host). host is note.link.url.host ?? "".
Hover popover binding: shown when hoveredHead == head; dismissing clears hoveredHead only if it is still that head. onHover(false) clears only when hoveredHead equals the head.
The doc comment above headCard reads 'One number tile: the count large, what it counts small beneath it.' which actually describes stat(); a misplaced comment in source.

B1->B2: the two static NSRegularExpression properties (private static let filesPattern and static let headPattern, the latter internal) were removed and replaced with inline Swift Regex literals matched via line.wholeMatch(of:); the old patterns were anchored with ^ and $ and the new ones rely on wholeMatch, with the same capture groups and the same U+2014 dash / U+2212 minus characters. The group() helper that mapped NSRange to Substring and the NSNotFound check for group 4 were replaced by typed optional captures (found.output.4 != nil, found.output.5 ?? ""). rawLine.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines) became rawLine.trimmed. Fonts moved from fixed sizes to text styles: "Merged" 15 semibold -> .title3 semibold; host line 11 -> .subheadline; heads-landed count 11 -> .subheadline; arrow.right 9 semibold -> .caption2 semibold; info.circle and note text 12 -> .callout; copied checkmark 11 semibold -> .subheadline semibold; head card name 13 semibold -> .body semibold, task 12 -> .callout, empty text 11 -> .subheadline, file paths 11 monospaced -> .subheadline monospaced; stat value 17 semibold monospacedDigit -> .title2 semibold monospacedDigit, stat label 10 medium -> .footnote medium; chip 11 monospaced -> .subheadline monospaced. Fixed symbol sizes 18 (merge icon) and 20 (seal) unchanged. File went from 298 to 286 lines. HydraMergeNote.headPattern is no longer an accessible symbol, so any external reference to it would have been removed in B2.

Digit matching: neither regex applies `.asciiOnlyDigits()`, and Swift Regex `\d` matches any Unicode decimal digit by default, while `Int(Substring)` parses only ASCII digits and fails past Int.max. So a files line with non-ASCII digits or an oversized number matches and is then dropped by `else { continue }` (lines 61-62), not turned into a note; a head line with such an index gets `index: Int(found.output.2) ?? 0` (line 48). A port whose `\d` is ASCII-only (for example JavaScript) would fail the match and turn such a files line into a note instead; match Unicode Nd digits (\p{Nd} with the u flag) to keep parity.

Card order (lines 100-216): header, stats row, heads row (only when heads non-empty, line 135), branch row (line 162), notes, buttons. The comment at lines 133-134 ("The branch chip spans whatever the arrow and the target leave, so the row runs the card's full width...") sits above `if !note.heads.isEmpty {`, not above the branch row it describes: a second misplaced comment besides the headCard one.
unresolved_questions: Who produces the merge note body (the generator of the '<n> files (+a −d) landed on ...' line, the 'Heads' section and the 'is up to date.' line) is in other files and must be matched byte-for-byte including U+2014 and U+2212. The callers of parse are DroppyCode/App/Views/Chat/TimelineRows.swift:296 `HydraMergeNote.parse(details, link: request)` and :1113 `HydraMergeNote.parse(outcome.details, link: request)`, both only after `MergeRequestLink(url: link)` succeeds.

files.purpose: Implements the floating glass Hydra team panel (HydraPanel) that shows one head 'on stage' with its live transcript (or a progress view when head details are hidden) and a top strip acting as the drag handle, holding a heads-count capsule that opens a popover list of heads, the stage head's name/provider/status/elapsed capsule, and pop-out/put-back and dismiss circle buttons. It also holds the finish-hold logic that keeps a just-finished head on stage for 2 s while a DotFieldSweep wave plays, the per-head popover rows with stop buttons, the native-head footer, and the shared HydraLiveInfo and HydraStatusText helpers that produce every head status string ('working', '· done in 12s · 3 steps · landed 2 files', 'Failed · ...').
